_comment: Copy to config.json (or set the LEVIATHAN_CONFIG environment variable to point at a different path). This file only contains the database and skill_dir settings; LLM and everything else is configured via environment variables or in-app settings, not here.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Priority: the LEVIATHAN_PG_DSN environment variable takes precedence over this file's database section. Pick one of two styles: (A) fill in the individual fields below; (B) only set database.dsn to a single full connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Style (B): remove the database section above and use a full DSN instead. When dsn is non-empty, the individual fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: The skills root directory (one skill per subdirectory, each containing a SKILL.md). Priority: the LEVIATHAN_SKILL_DIR environment variable > this field > the default (the skills/ directory next to the executable). Leave blank or remove this field to use the default. A relative path is resolved against the current working directory.
